description.en:
When a girl abused by her father wakes up in a novel as Luella Masimelle, the cruel stepmother of the protagonist Hirah, she is determined to make things different. To do this, she proposes a contractual marriage to Duke Huppert to make him Hirah's guardian, but the duke surprisingly seems genuinely interested in her. And with the once timid Hirah also starting to open up and show affection to her, Luella begins to wonder if she'll finally have a happy family... Or is it all too good to be true?

---
The oven exploded while I was baking bread, and I faced death along with my abusive father, who had come seeking me. Then I woke up in a novel I was reading. “I’m sorry, Mo..ther. I’m not hurt.”

In the body of the villainous stepmother “Leila”, who abused the male protagonist “Hirua” when he was young, but was eventually executed by Hirua when he returned as the emperor! In order to help Hirua leave the stepmother’s wraith and live happily, I encounter the Marquis “Lacias Huppert”, who played a crucial role in the original, and proposed a contractual marriage. “Can we have a real marriage instead of a contractual one?”

“Oh, can I sleep with Mother too?” Contrary to the plan to leave only the two of them after a year, it seems that both the Marquis and Hirua have unexpectedly started to become attached to me.
description.fr: Alors que je préparais des madeleines, le four explosa soudainement et je me retrouvai dans le roman que je lisais, et ni plus ni moins que dans le corps de l'horrible belle-mère Ruella, qui prenait un malin plaisir à maltraiter le protagoniste : Hirua. Ce dernier finira alors par l'exécuter une fois devenu empereur. C'est pourquoi, dans le but d'aider Hirua à s'émanciper, j'ai eu l'idée de proposer un mariage blanc au duc Lasias Weffer, qui dans le roman avait fini par devenir le parrain de Hirua. Je comptais leur fausser compagnie au bout d'un an, mais voilà que le duc, comme l'enfant, commençaient à se prendre d'affection pour moi.
description.id: Setelah mengalami kecelakaan tak terduga, aku tiba-tiba terbangun sebagai Luella Mashmell, tokoh ibu tiri jahat yang bahkan tega mengusir anak sendiri! Saat tahu bahwa takdirku adalah mati di tangan anak yang selama ini Luella perlakukan dengan buruk, aku bertekad untuk menjadi ibu yang baik bagi anakku, Hirua, dan membesarkannya dengan baik. Untuk itu, aku harus mendekati pria yang dalam novel kelak akan menjadi ayah angkatnya. Tapi pria yang misterius itu dikabarkan berdarah dingin dan benci wanita! Bisakah aku mendekatinya dan membuat anakku bahagia, hingga akhirnya menjauhi kematianku?
description.ja: 幼少期の虐待により暴君になって帰ってきた息子に殺される母親に憑依してしまった私。このまま処刑されるわけにはいかない!死なないためになんでもすると覚悟を決めたけど……どうしてこんなに楽勝なの?おまけに夫が私に執着し始めて…
description.ko:
빵을 굽던 오븐이 폭발하며 자신을 찾아온 가정폭력범 아버지와 함께 죽음을 맞이한 나는 읽고 있던 소설 속에서 눈을 떴다. 

"죄... 죄송합니다. 어...머니. 아, 프지 않아요." 

어린 시절 남주 '히르아'를 학대하지만 결국 훗날 황제가 되어 돌아온 히르아의 손에 사형당하고 마는 악역 계모 '르엘라'의 몸에! 

히르아가 계모의 품을 떠나 행복하게 지낼 수 있도록 원작에서 그의 대부가 되어줬던 '라시아스 위페르' 공작을 만나 계약결혼은 제안하는데... 

“계약 결혼 말고 진짜 결혼은 안 됩니까?” 
“어, 어머니랑 같이 자도 돼요?” 

1년 후 둘만 남기고 떠나겠다는 계획과는 다르게 어쩐지 공작과 히르아가 나에게 집착하기 시작하는데...!
description.zh: 常年遭受父亲的暴力，又因一场火灾丧命的可怜少女，就连穿越，也是成了会被暴君杀害的反派继母。 这次一定要好好苟住，我不信从小就教这个“小暴君”仁义礼信，他长大还能杀了我不成？ 哎呦哎呦，他好乖乖好好rua！嗯？小暴君他爹怎么也来求rua？
description.zh-hk: 從小遭受父親家庭暴力的我，直到長大後仍然無法逃離他，唯一的慰藉是小說裡與自己境況相似卻成功活出反轉的主角。然而某一天，經歷爆炸意外死去的我，居然重生並附身到小說中惡角，也就是希爾亞的母親身上!想幫助希爾亞的我，卻屢屢被用驚懼又害怕的眼神盯著看，這該怎麼辦才好...?我一定要讓希爾亞看見我的真心，並幫助他獲得幸福人生!
